name: Aave
description: Aave helps users explore live Aave V3 and V4 markets, review wallet positions and DAO governance, simulate lending actions, and prepare non-custodial transactions. Every transaction is returned unsigned: the plugin reads the markets and writes the call, and the wallet stays with the user.

prompts.text: Where can I earn the most on stablecoins across Aave right now?
Which pays more for USDC right now, Aave V3 or V4 on Ethereum?
